status: registered 2026-11-16; nothing run on the test set (it does not exist yet)
question: Does the lean core (one TF-IDF ranker over earlier dated store posts, plus naming only when it and the frontier model agree) beat today's product on reports published after 2026-11-03?
requested_by: product owner, 2026-11-16 ('ok do it' after the from-scratch review; plan cheerful-meandering-puddle.md)
nature: test; registered before the test set is built

frozen.ranker: store text's TF-IDF (1-2-grams, min_df 2, IDF over actor documents, log1p, L2, cosine, z-score, softmax), computed incrementally; no prominence prior (--no-prior); store posts masked at the report's level (--corpus matched); actors = the ATT&CK groups the store labels
frozen.reading_of_the_store: posts available strictly before the report's date, its own post and copies hidden (StoreMembers.hidden_for), the store pin of its date (pins.pin_for); whole store as the store holds it when the test runs
frozen.naming_rule: name A only when the core's first choice is A and GPT-5.6 Sol (openai/gpt-5.6-sol, effort medium, the registered prompt of scripts/fresh_llm_attribution.py, id-first matching) decides 'name' with A as its first matched candidate; margin 0

secondary: behavior with the report's own publisher hidden

development_results.note: all in-sample or development; the sets were used before. data/core/dev_*.json
dropped: the prominence prior (store_train 47 -> 61 without it, fresh 21 -> 23)
a margin threshold alone as the naming rule: the smallest margin keeping wrong names <= 2% on store_train (0.27) names 9 of 322 posts with 4 wrong, and almost nothing on fresh
development_results.exactness: with the store's own masking and the prior the ranker reproduces store text on fresh2 exactly (84 report-reading-arm cases, max difference 0.0; scripts/core_reproduce.py)

test_set.window: posts published from 2026-11-03 (the confirmation window, shared with model_second_opinion_2026-11-11.json; both registered before any scoring)
test_set.build: make store-update (approved 2026-11-16), make store-extract, scripts/prepare_fresh_reports.py --from-store with the window, then the label review in amendments.json, then freeze hashes here
test_set.size: run when it holds at least 30 known reports (descriptive); a decision needs 60 known reports
arms: today's product (GPU run, technique head on)

decision_rule: With at least 60 known reports, the core wins when, at the behaviour reading, its right-first count is at least the product's and the naming rule gives no more wrong names (known reports named wrongly plus open-set reports named) than the product. Below 60 known reports every reading is descriptive. A win allows only the display-only core answer behind CORE_ANSWER_ENABLED=false; no default changes without the product owner.
budget: OpenRouter at most $10 in total for this programme (about $0.055 a report and reading)
limits: the store's labels come from a name-count rule, so some test labels can be wrong until the label review
store text is strongest where the same publisher wrote about the actor before; the own-publisher-hidden reading is reported beside the primary one
the decisive set (2025-01..2026-02) is spent and is not used
